summary: Comprehensive testing of Xenon Messenger MVP completed. Backend: 38/39 tests passed (97.5% success rate). Frontend: All major UI flows working correctly including onboarding, tab navigation, contacts, settings, theme switching, and modals. One minor backend test failure (edge case in 'since' filter) and one minor frontend issue (identity switcher scroll visibility).

minor.issue: Test expects messages AFTER timestamp, but first message has exact same timestamp. Backend correctly uses $gt (greater than) which excludes exact match. This is a test logic issue, not a backend bug.

issues: Identity switcher button at top of screen may scroll out of view when navigating between tabs. Consider making it sticky or always visible.

test_categories.identities: 6/6 passed - Create (XEN-XXXX-XXXX format), list, get, delete, disposable
test_categories.contacts: 5/5 passed - Add with fingerprint & trust score 40-95, idempotent, 404 for unknown peer, list, verify
test_categories.chats: 12/12 passed - Direct (reuses existing), group, broadcast, list, get, update (vault/ghost/burn/decoy/name), fingerprint (8x5 SHA-256)
test_categories.messages: 6/7 passed - Send, updates chat preview, list, mark read, destroy, self-destruct (2s timer verified)
test_categories.typing: 3/3 passed - Set, get, TTL (4s expiry verified)
test_categories.panic: 1/1 passed - Wipes identity, contacts, chats, messages
test_categories.ai: 2/2 passed - Summarize and smart-reply both working with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY

frontend_test_results.onboarding: ✓ Working - Name input, Generate Identity button, navigation to tabs
frontend_test_results.tab_navigation: ✓ Working - Chats, Contacts, Settings tabs all functional
frontend_test_results.contacts_tab: ✓ Working - My XID card with copy, DISCOVER section with suggestions, add contact modal
frontend_test_results.settings_tab: ✓ Working - Identity Manager, Theme selector (4 themes), Ghost/Decoy toggles, Vault PIN, Panic Mode
frontend_test_results.theme_modal: ✓ Working - Shows 4 themes (Obsidian, Frost, Nebula, Amber Vault) with palette preview
frontend_test_results.identity_switcher: ⚠ Minor issue - Button exists but may scroll out of view

context_for_next_testing_agent: First comprehensive test pass. Backend is solid with 97.5% pass rate. Frontend UI flows all working. Only minor issues: (1) test logic for 'since' parameter edge case, (2) identity switcher scroll visibility. AI features (summarize, smart-reply) confirmed working with Emergent LLM. Self-destruct and typing TTL verified with actual timers. No critical bugs found.
